hero.subtitle: 5 yildan ortiq tajriba: korporativ darajadagi veb-ilovalarni arxitektura qarorlaridan tortib production’gacha yetkazaman. Longhorn Logistics Group’da frontend yo‘nalishini boshqaraman va Expensify’ning open-source ilovasiga hissa qo‘shaman.
